app.name: KickWii (no oficial)
app.short_description: Unofficial Kick client for the Nintendo Wii
app.long_description:
Watch Kick live streams on your Wii. Browse a live home grid and a category catalog, search for channels, open a channel page, and use live chat (read anonymously, or write when signed in). Live playback is H.264 + AAC decoded on the Wii. There is no VOD support.
Sign in with a QR code. The session is saved on SD, or on USB if no SD is present, and can be refreshed or signed out from Settings. Follow and Subscribe open a QR code to the official Kick page on your phone; the Wii does not make payments or change follows by itself. 4:3 and 16:9 are supported. Adult and gambling channels are hidden by default.
Settings has an optional field for a companion server on a PC in your network (HTTP proxy or transcoded playback). Without a server, the Wii talks to Kick over HTTPS for thumbnails, avatars, categories, banners, video, and chat.
Controls: Wii Remote pointer and buttons, including the D-Pad (cruceta). A Classic Controller button layout, a GameCube controller, and a USB keyboard are also supported.
This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Kick or Nintendo; the icon is original art. Intro music: Claude Debussy, Clair de lune, piano by Laurens Goedhart (public domain, Wikimedia Commons). Licensed under GPL-3.0.
